blocks.html: Focuses on maximizing value during a transition, whether the business is being sold, merged, or strategically dissolved.

blocks.text: Determining the true market value of the company’s tangible and intangible assets. We provide independent, defensible Business and Intellectual Property (IP) Valuation services to support strategic decision-making, transactions, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements across global markets

Our Business Valuation services support mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, shareholder matters, restructuring, and strategic planning. Valuations are prepared using internationally accepted methodologies and tailored to the purpose of the engagement.

Our IP Valuation advisory helps organizations assess the economic value of trademarks, patents, software, brands, and other intangible assets—supporting licensing, transfer pricing, fundraising, and commercialization strategies.
With a strong focus on credibility and clarity, our valuations stand up to investor, auditor, and regulatory scrutiny.
